title: Yoda's great power
description: The filming of The Empire Strikes Back lasted from March 5 until September 24, 1979. Some of the Hoth sequences were filmed in Norway, while scenes on Dagobah, Cloud City and inside Echo Base were shot at Elstree Studios, England. During production, the film went seriously over-budget and behind schedule. To secure additional funds required to complete the film, George Lucas was forced to approach 20th Century Fox for a renegotiated deal. The studio was given more profit in exchange for guaranteeing a sizable financial loan, enabling the relieved Lucas to continue filming while retaining all sequel/merchandising rights.
